limitations.title: App script overhead
limitations.detail: Each installed Shopify app usually injects its own scripts on every page.

limitations.title: Checkout lock-in
limitations.detail: Checkout and payments run on Shopify and cannot be self-hosted.

manualRebuild.title: Cart, checkout and payments
manualRebuild.detail: Storefront pages are recreated statically. Cart and checkout need Shopify (for example via the Storefront API) or another commerce backend.

manualRebuild.title: Product catalogue and inventory
manualRebuild.detail: Only crawled products are captured. The catalogue, variants and stock live in Shopify.
